protocol.task: next-year new edges among historically seen authors; cold-start and repeated ties separately counted
protocol.sampling: at least three papers in trailing five years and two historical neighbors; SHA256 order, no future labels

limitations: Development results only, not a frozen test or paper-ready claim.
Author responses are complete relative to the published dataset; real source completeness must be audited separately.
Scores with ties use fixed author ID ordering; EdgeBank has no discrimination for new edges.
No binary accuracy on arbitrary sampled nonedges; fixed future positives remain in recall denominator.
superseded_reason: Initial development smoke run stopped exhausted-frontier targets early; high-budget denominators were inconsistent. Replaced by v2 forward-filled fixed denominators.
